sloka: तमेवमुक्त्वा राजर्षिः पूरुं राज्यविवर्धनम् ।अभिषेकेण सम्पूज्य आश्रमं प्रविवेश ह ।। ७.५९.१७ ॥
transliteration: tamevamuktvā rājarṣiḥ pūruṁ rājyavivardhanam ।abhiṣekeṇa sampūjya āśramaṁ praviveśa ha ।। 7.59.17 ॥

translations.english: Having thus spoken, the royal sage Yayati honored Puru, who was destined to expand the kingdom, with a coronation and then entered his hermitage.
